findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_financials, get_peer_comparison, get_returns, get_bulk_block_deals, get_fo_participant_activity, search_company_disclosures, get_event_context, get_market_breadth, get_fx_reference_rates, get_sector_fpi_investment, get_ipos, get_financial_trends · Private data: get_watchlist, get_bulk_block_deals, get_insider_trades, get_index_valuation, get_ipos · Public sink: get_financials, get_peer_comparison, get_price_history, get_valuation_history, get_dividends, get_corporate_actions, get_upcoming_results, get_fx_reference_rates, get_market_calendar, get_financial_trends, get_pledge_trend · Destructive: get_filing_extract, remove_from_watchlist, run_preset_screen.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_financials, get_peer_comparison, get_returns, get_bulk_block_deals, get_fo_participant_activity, search_company_disclosures, get_event_context, get_market_breadth, get_fx_reference_rates, get_sector_fpi_investment, get_ipos, get_financial_trends · Private data: get_watchlist, get_bulk_block_deals, get_insider_trades, get_index_valuation, get_ipos · Public sink: get_financials, get_peer_comparison, get_price_history, get_valuation_history, get_dividends, get_corporate_actions, get_upcoming_results, get_fx_reference_rates, get_market_calendar, get_financial_trends, get_pledge_trend · Destructive: get_filing_extract, remove_from_watchlist, run_preset_screen

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
